from openpyxl import load_workbook
from math import isclose
src='/root/nasa_budget_incomplete.xlsx'; out='/root/nasa_budget_recovered.xlsx'
a=load_workbook(src,data_only=False); w=load_workbook(out,data_only=False)
# Confirm all placeholders are gone and no non-placeholder values changed.
remaining=[f'{s.title}!{c.coordinate}' for s in w for row in s.iter_rows() for c in row if c.value=='???']
assert not remaining, remaining
changed=[]
for old_s,new_s in zip(a.worksheets,w.worksheets):
    assert old_s.title==new_s.title and old_s.max_row==new_s.max_row and old_s.max_column==new_s.max_column
    for old_row,new_row in zip(old_s.iter_rows(),new_s.iter_rows()):
        for old_c,new_c in zip(old_row,new_row):
            if old_c.value!=new_c.value:
                assert old_c.value=='???' and isinstance(new_c.value,(int,float))
                assert old_c.style_id==new_c.style_id and old_c.number_format==new_c.number_format
                changed.append(f'{new_s.title}!{new_c.coordinate}={new_c.value}')
assert len(changed)==15, len(changed)
# Independently recompute every numeric relationship in the workbook.
b=w['Budget by Directorate']; y=w['YoY Changes (%)']; sh=w['Directorate Shares (%)']; g=w['Growth Analysis']
for r in range(4,14):
    assert b.cell(r,11).value==sum(b.cell(r,c).value for c in range(2,11)), ('total',r)
for r in range(4,13):
    br=r+1  # 2016 at budget row 5, etc.
    assert y.cell(r,1).value==b.cell(br,1).value
    for c in range(2,12):
        expected=round((b.cell(br,c).value/b.cell(br-1,c).value-1)*100,2)
        assert isclose(y.cell(r,c).value,expected,abs_tol=1e-12), ('yoy',r,c,y.cell(r,c).value,expected)
for r in range(4,14):
    assert sh.cell(r,1).value==b.cell(r,1).value
    for c in range(2,11):
        expected=round(b.cell(r,c).value/b.cell(r,11).value*100,2)
        assert isclose(sh.cell(r,c).value,expected,abs_tol=1e-12), ('share',r,c,sh.cell(r,c).value,expected)
# Growth spans FY2019 through FY2024 (budget rows 8:13).
for c in range(2,11):
    v19=b.cell(8,c).value; v24=b.cell(13,c).value
    assert isclose(g.cell(4,c).value,round(((v24/v19)**(1/5)-1)*100,2),abs_tol=1e-12), ('cagr',c)
    assert g.cell(5,c).value==v19 and g.cell(6,c).value==v24
    assert g.cell(7,c).value==v24-v19
    assert isclose(g.cell(8,c).value,round(sum(b.cell(r,c).value for r in range(8,14))/6,1),abs_tol=1e-12), ('avg',c)
print('PASS: 15 numeric replacements; no ??? remain; all 10 totals, 90 YoY values, 90 shares, and 45 growth values recompute exactly at displayed precision.')
print('\n'.join(changed))
